The '''Mk 2e/W heavy laser cannon''' was a type of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. [[Heavy Tracker/Legends|Heavy Trackers]] were armed with Mk 2e/W heavy laser cannons.<ref name="MBC">''[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles Companion]]''</ref> [[Heavy Tracker/Legends|Heavy Trackers]] were armed with a single Mk 2e/W heavy laser cannon.<ref name="SBP">{{JournalCite|9|Stand at Bhir'khi Pass (article)}}</ref>
